rules.bend: Manifest-only .bend; UTF-8 splitlines; code excludes blank and first-nonspace # lines; declarations use line-start def/law/type followed by whitespace.
rules.support: Separate physical-line and UTF-8-byte groups; generated ordinary runtime and images are not added to maintained source totals.
rules.concepts: Declarations are proxies, not semantic concepts. No numeric concept total or reduction is claimed.

native.scope: Native image/source freshly hashed; C identity is retained admission metadata, not a new C comparison.

phase66.limitation: Source identity only. Does not rerun tests or prove unchanged whole compiler/image execution.

phase82.limitation: Source identity only. Does not rerun tests or prove unchanged whole compiler/image execution.

mixedRuntimeCoverage.scope: Union of unchanged Node fixture passes and separately admitted exact-module Bun passes. Does not rewrite Node statuses or count graphics deferral/shared failure/unprintable exemptions as executable passes.

historicalConformance.scope: Historical observations only. No Phase91 target is executed by this census; no combined conformance percentage is meaningful.

boundaries: All active Bend modules match checked compiler07 and installed release.checkout; all installed release files are rehashed. Historical semantic evidence is not promoted by source hashes alone.
